# host contract

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-contract-docs.js from packages/development/toolchain/categories/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract version: `1.0`

The `host` category defines 9 capabilities: 6 required and 3 optional. An adapter implementing this category must provide every required capability; a command that needs an optional capability the resolved adapter lacks uses the capability's fallback when one is named.

## Capabilities

| Capability | Required | Side effect | Inputs | Outputs | Fallback | Added in minor | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host.auth-status` | required | no | `scope` | `authenticated` | - | - | Report whether the resolved host CLI is authenticated. |
| `host.change-request-create` | required | yes | `baseBranch`, `headBranch`, `title`, `description` | `id`, `url`, `state`, `baseBranch`, `headBranch` | - | - | Open a change request (pull/merge request) from a pushed branch. |
| `host.change-request-view` | required | no | `id` | `id`, `url`, `state`, `baseBranch`, `headBranch`, `checks` | - | - | Read a single change request, including its state and checks. |
| `host.change-request-list` | required | no | `filter` | `items` | - | - | List change requests, optionally filtered (for example by state or branch). |
| `host.change-request-checks` | required | no | `id` | `id`, `checks` | - | - | Read the status checks attached to a change request. |
| `host.change-request-threads` | optional | no | `id` | `id`, `threads` | - | - | List review comment threads on a change request. Optional, not required: not every shipped host adapter has a PR-comment-thread CLI surface (for example Azure DevOps' `az repos pr` allowlist, TRD-040, has none), and there is no generic cross-tool fallback for review threads, so this carries no `fallback` field. |
| `host.change-request-reviews` | optional | no | `id` | `id`, `reviewDecision`, `mergeable`, `mergeStateStatus`, `reviews`, `threads` | - | - | Read the review state of a change request: the host's review decision, mergeability, the LATEST decisive review per reviewer with the reviewer's host-reported account type (`authorType`: `Bot` or `User`, never inferred from a name), and the UNRESOLVED review threads (`{path, body}`). Optional, not required: not every host adapter has a review-state CLI surface (Azure DevOps' `az repos pr` allowlist has none), and there is no generic cross-tool fallback, so this carries no `fallback` field. A caller that gates on review state (`/ensemble:pr-merge`) MUST fail closed when this resolves `UNAVAILABLE` or returns `ok:false`, never treat it as "no reviews". |
| `host.change-request-merge` | required | yes | `id`, `method` | `id`, `state` | - | - | Merge a change request once its checks pass. `method` (optional, TRD-2026-8d825f54 PR 9 fix round, item 2) selects the normalized merge strategy (squash\|merge\|rebase); omitted defaults to `squash`, preserving behavior from before this input existed. Not every adapter supports every method -- an adapter without a given method declared in its own `variants.method` fails the call closed with `NOT_ALLOWED`, never silently falling back to a different strategy or passing the caller's value through unvalidated. Optional: GitHub has no native work-item-linking capability (only Azure DevOps' `az repos pr work-item add` does, TRD-040/TRD-041), and there is no generic cross-tool fallback, so this carries no `fallback` field. |

## Details

### host.auth-status

Report whether the resolved host CLI is authenticated.

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `scope`
- Outputs: `authenticated`
- Fallback: none

### host.change-request-create

Open a change request (pull/merge request) from a pushed branch.

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `baseBranch`, `headBranch`, `title`, `description`
- Outputs: `id`, `url`, `state`, `baseBranch`, `headBranch`
- Fallback: none

### host.change-request-view

Read a single change request, including its state and checks.

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`, `url`, `state`, `baseBranch`, `headBranch`, `checks`
- Fallback: none

### host.change-request-list

List change requests, optionally filtered (for example by state or branch).

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `filter`
- Outputs: `items`
- Fallback: none

### host.change-request-checks

Read the status checks attached to a change request.

- Status: required
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`, `checks`
- Fallback: none

### host.change-request-threads

List review comment threads on a change request. Optional, not required: not every shipped host adapter has a PR-comment-thread CLI surface (for example Azure DevOps' `az repos pr` allowlist, TRD-040, has none), and there is no generic cross-tool fallback for review threads, so this carries no `fallback` field.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`, `threads`
- Fallback: none

### host.change-request-reviews

Read the review state of a change request: the host's review decision, mergeability, the LATEST decisive review per reviewer with the reviewer's host-reported account type (`authorType`: `Bot` or `User`, never inferred from a name), and the UNRESOLVED review threads (`{path, body}`). Optional, not required: not every host adapter has a review-state CLI surface (Azure DevOps' `az repos pr` allowlist has none), and there is no generic cross-tool fallback, so this carries no `fallback` field. A caller that gates on review state (`/ensemble:pr-merge`) MUST fail closed when this resolves `UNAVAILABLE` or returns `ok:false`, never treat it as "no reviews".

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `id`
- Outputs: `id`, `reviewDecision`, `mergeable`, `mergeStateStatus`, `reviews`, `threads`
- Fallback: none

### host.change-request-merge

Merge a change request once its checks pass. `method` (optional, TRD-2026-8d825f54 PR 9 fix round, item 2) selects the normalized merge strategy (squash|merge|rebase); omitted defaults to `squash`, preserving behavior from before this input existed. Not every adapter supports every method -- an adapter without a given method declared in its own `variants.method` fails the call closed with `NOT_ALLOWED`, never silently falling back to a different strategy or passing the caller's value through unvalidated. Adding this as an optional input to an EXISTING capability (not a new capability) needs no contract version bump: `checkCompat`/`checkAdditiveOnly` (`contracts.js`) gate capability-level `required`/removal/addition only, never a capability's own `inputs` list.

- Status: required
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `method`
- Outputs: `id`, `state`
- Fallback: none

### host.change-request-link-work-item

Link a change request to a tracker work item. Optional: GitHub has no native work-item-linking capability (only Azure DevOps' `az repos pr work-item add` does, TRD-040/TRD-041), and there is no generic cross-tool fallback, so this carries no `fallback` field.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: yes
- Inputs: `id`, `workItemId`
- Outputs: `id`, `workItemId`
- Fallback: none
